email.subject: RFP: Multi-Service Enterprise Modernization and Agentic Workflow Automation
email.body:
Dear NovaCorp Team,

We are looking to engage a technical partner for two initiatives:
1. Deploy the Atlas agentic workflow engine for automated email request extraction with human approval queues.
2. Migrate our legacy banking services to containerized Kubernetes on AWS with Prometheus observability and OpenTelemetry.

Please confirm architectural feasibility across both services.

Sincerely,
Procurement Director

expected_behavior.scenario: Multi-service proposal covering Atlas agentic workflows and cloud modernization
